summary: Tenaris S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release announcing unaudited third-quarter 2026 results, comparable to a routine quarterly earnings release for a US domestic issuer. Net sales were $3,102 million (+5% q/q, +4% y/y), operating income $598 million, net income $521 million, and earnings per ADS $1.01; EBITDA reached $756 million at a 24.4% margin. Free cash flow was $268 million and net cash stood at $3.8 billion at September 30, 2026. No transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; the filing carries no special-situations or risk-arb angle.
